description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'EmployeeActionSummaryAPI' within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides a method 'getOne' that retrieves a summarized list of pending actions related to an employee's dashboard widget, such as leave requests, timesheets, appraisals, self-reviews, and scheduled interviews. The class uses various traits and dependencies to determine accessible entities, enabled modules, and to generate the action summaries. The file includes documentation, licensing info, and API annotations for documentation generation.
